entities.name: IDENTITY RESPONSE
entities.description: Message sent by the UE in response to an identity request from the network.

entities.name: T3570
entities.description: Timer used by the network during the identification procedure.

entities.name: Network
entities.description: The network entity that receives the IDENTITY RESPONSE message and stops timer T3570.

relations.description: Receipt of the IDENTITY RESPONSE message causes the network to stop timer T3570.
The network stops timer T3570 upon receipt of the IDENTITY RESPONSE message.
